mechanism: Isoniazid inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, reducing nortriptyline metabolism and increasing tricyclic antidepressant plasma concentrations, while both drugs carry anticholinergic and CNS depressant effects.
action: Monitor for tricyclic toxicity including anticholinergic symptoms, cardiac arrhythmias, and CNS effects; consider nortriptyline dose reduction or therapeutic drug monitoring during concurrent use.
